title: MkDocs configuration refined for Material for MkDocs
description: The MkDocs configuration schema, refined with the theme and extra keys the Material for MkDocs theme reads. The base schema is pulled in through a relative reference to the vendored copy next to this file; a remote reference would silently drop the whole base branch, because a bundled schema resolves references against its own file only. Both refined keys wrap their definition in an `anyOf` rather than naming it with a bare `$ref`: the base schema describes `theme` and `extra` as well, and the platform merges the two branches of the `allOf` per key - measured, a bare `$ref` is merged away and the popup below `extra` stays empty, while a branch of an `anyOf` is walked on its own and keeps its keys.

materialTheme.description: The theme block of a site rendered with Material for MkDocs.

name.description: The installed theme rendering the site. `material` selects Material for MkDocs.

custom_dir.description: A directory with template overrides, resolved relative to the directory holding the configuration file.

static_templates.description: Templates rendered to a static page of their own, for example `404.html`.

language.description: The language the theme renders its own labels in, as a two letter code such as `en` or `de`.

locale.description: The MkDocs locale of the site. Material for MkDocs reads `language` instead.

direction.description: The writing direction of the site.

logo.description: An image used as the logo in the header, relative to `docs_dir`. Takes precedence over `theme.icon.logo`.

favicon.description: The icon shown in the browser tab, relative to `docs_dir`.

font.description: The typefaces the theme loads from Google Fonts, or `false` to load no web fonts at all.

text.description: The typeface used for headings and body text, for example `Roboto`.

code.description: The typeface used for code, for example `Roboto Mono`.

features.description: The optional behaviours of the theme to switch on.

palette.description: The colours of the site. A single mapping paints one palette; a sequence of mappings offers a colour scheme toggle.

materialPaletteSingle.description: A single palette of the theme.

scheme.description: The ground the palette is painted on.

primary.description: The primary colour, used for the header, links and accents of the navigation.

accent.description: The accent colour, used for elements the reader can interact with.

media.description: A media query deciding when this palette applies. The theme is built around `(prefers-color-scheme: light)`, `(prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `(prefers-color-scheme)` for the palette of the system preference.

materialPaletteItem.description: One palette of a colour scheme toggle.

scheme.description: The ground this palette is painted on.

primary.description: The primary colour of this palette.

accent.description: The accent colour of this palette.

media.description: A media query deciding when this palette is chosen automatically. The theme is built around `(prefers-color-scheme: light)`, `(prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `(prefers-color-scheme)` for the palette of the system preference.

materialPaletteToggle.description: The button switching to the next palette of the sequence.

icon.description: The icon of the toggle button, as an icon reference such as `material/brightness-7`.

name.description: The tooltip of the toggle button.

materialIcons.description: The icons the theme uses instead of its built-in ones. Every value is an icon reference such as `material/tag`, `fontawesome/brands/github` or `octicons/mark-github-16`.

logo.description: The icon shown in the header when `theme.logo` is not set.

repo.description: The icon of the repository link in the header.

edit.description: The icon of the edit button, shown when `content.action.edit` is enabled.

view.description: The icon of the view source button, shown when `content.action.view` is enabled.

menu.description: The icon opening the navigation drawer on small screens.

alternate.description: The icon of the language selector.

search.description: The icon of the search field.

share.description: The icon of the share search button.

close.description: The icon closing search and dialogues.

top.description: The icon of the back to top button.

previous.description: The icon of the link to the previous page.

next.description: The icon of the link to the next page.

annotation.description: The icon marking an annotation inside a code block.

admonition.description: The icon of each admonition type, keyed by the type name such as `note` or `warning`.

tag.description: The icon of each tag, keyed by the tag name.

materialExtra.description: The extra block passed to the templates. Material for MkDocs reads the keys below; every other key stays available to the site and to other features, so `version` (mike) and `alternate` (i18n) are deliberately left unconstrained.

social.description: The accounts of the project, rendered as a row of icons in the footer.

icon.description: The icon of the link, as an icon reference such as `fontawesome/brands/github`.

link.description: The address the icon links to.

name.description: The tooltip of the link. Derived from the address when absent.

analytics.description: The site analytics provider and the feedback widget below each page.

provider.description: The analytics provider the theme loads. The theme ships support for `google`.

property.description: The property or measurement id of the analytics account.

feedback.description: The feedback widget rendered below each page.

title.description: The question asked above the rating buttons.

ratings.description: The buttons the reader can answer with.

icon.description: The icon of the rating button.

name.description: The tooltip of the rating button.

data.description: The value reported to the analytics provider for this rating.

note.description: The note shown after the reader answered.

consent.description: The cookie consent dialogue shown before analytics are loaded.

title.description: The heading of the consent dialogue.

description.description: The text of the consent dialogue.

cookies.description: The cookie groups the reader may accept or reject, keyed by group name.

actions.description: The buttons of the consent dialogue, in the order they are rendered.

generator.description: Whether the "Made with Material for MkDocs" notice is rendered in the footer.

status.description: The badges a page may carry through its `status` front matter key, keyed by status name with the icon reference as value.
